name: RERO ILS
description: Large-scale ILS that can be run as a service with consortial features, intended primarily for library networks. Includes most standard modules (circulation, acquisitions, cataloging,...) and a web-based public and professional interface. ([Demo](https://ils.test.rero.ch/), [Source Code](https://github.com/rero/rero-ils)) `AGPL-3.0` `Python/Docker`
